blocks.text: To help you find users quickly, you can use User Search for Digital Experience (ZDX). User Search is available by Users and Devices.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Digital Experience > Users > User Search.
Users: Enter an email or name to search for a user.
Devices: Enter a device hostname to search for a device.
The first 10 most relevant results are displayed. To display more results, you can:
Click View All Search Results for to display a list of all search results for the text you entered.
Click Load More to display 10 more results consecutively until complete. If there are fewer than 10 results, the Load More button does not display.
Click the relevant name or email to view the user details page for that user. To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

blocks.text: If a user profile was recently deleted, that profile is displayed in the search results. Clicking the deleted user profile and accessing the user page also indicates that the profile is deleted. For data retention limits on user information, see Ranges and Limitations.
The Search keeps a history of the last 5 users whose details you viewed. If a deleted user profile was part of the search history, that is also indicated.
